# Lab 9.4: Visualise Data in Notebooks

## What We Are Going to Do
Build charts from query results and BigQuery DataFrames inside the notebook.

## Steps

1. **[Console] Line chart from a magic query.**

2. **[Console] Bar chart with BigQuery DataFrames.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">import bigframes.pandas as bpd
products = bpd.read_gbq("bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products")
products.groupby("department")["retail_price"].mean().plot.bar(title="Average price by department")</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


3. **[Console] Scatter plot of a sample.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • PYTHON
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">items = bpd.read_gbq("bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products")
items[["cost", "retail_price"]].sample(n=2000).plot.scatter(x="cost", y="retail_price", alpha=0.3)</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Always aggregate or sample before plotting large data.

4. **[Console] Use the built-in chart view.** Run any `%%bigquery` cell without a variable name. The output table has a **chart** button for quick charts without code.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| pandas plots | Work on magic query results |
| bigframes `.plot` | Aggregates in BigQuery, plots in the notebook |
| Sampling | Keeps charts fast |
| Built-in charts | No code needed |
